mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% (walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% (walk-forward Rank IC < -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction that depresses corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 combined with real GDP contraction (GDPC1 < 11700) signals severe supply-side disruption that reduces corporate output capacity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105 and GDPC1 < 11700 (walk-forward Rank IC < -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 136,000 signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 136,000 (walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 215 signals accelerating inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 215 (walk-forward Rank IC < -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a recession (GDPC1 < 11700), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) amplifies consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 < 11700 and HOUST declines (walk-forward Rank IC < -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) indicates aggressive monetary stimulus during economic distress, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and UNRATE > 6.5 (walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05).
